message: Turn 50 fixed at cc5fe35bda71363ae5bd01e39a4794cbcb2c40cf, Dispatcher 2.2.17. Changed files: .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py, .agent-handoff/dispatcher-runtime.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_finalize.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_blank.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_bootstrap.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_rebind.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_replace.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_restore.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_resume.py, .agent-handoff/test_signal_fetch.py. Installer unchanged and still version-dynamic. Tests: python3 -m py_compile dispatcher.py dispatcher-runtime.py test_control_finalize.py test_control_replace.py test_control_resume.py test_control_blank.py test_control_bootstrap.py test_control_rebind.py test_control_page.py test_control_restore.py test_signal_fetch.py exit 0; python3 test_control_finalize.py printed test_control_finalize: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_replace.py printed test_control_replace: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_resume.py printed test_control_resume: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_rebind.py printed test_control_rebind: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_blank.py printed test_control_blank: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_bootstrap.py printed test_control_bootstrap: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_page.py printed test_control_page: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_restore.py printed test_control_restore: OK, exit 0; python3 test_signal_fetch.py printed test_signal_fetch: OK, exit 0. Finalize semantics: exactly one URL-scoped rescue applies only when the saved URL is still the old control URL, rebind_status=failed, rebind_bootstrap_sent=true, rebind_failure_reason=no_new_url, rebind_replacement_count>=1, replacement_status=failed, and replacement_failure_reason=no_new_url. It does not apply to other failure reasons, bootstrap not sent, or rebind_status=done. No new page is created and CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP is never refilled. The latch rebind_finalize_for_url/count/status is written before any submit. A read-only scan of the marked ai-dispatcher-rebind-replacement page and other open ChatGPT pages commits a usable new /c/ URL only when that page shows the exact CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP user message or CONTROL READY. A marker-only user message is not identity. Home '/' is never persisted. Unrelated conversation pages are not navigated. If the marked page is still on ChatGPT home and the exact user message or CONTROL READY is already present, the dispatcher does not resend; it waits up to 60s and scans. If no URL appears, status becomes submitted with rebind_submission_status=confirmed and rebind_url_status=pending, so a later poll can still commit without another submit. If the composer still contains the exact CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP text and there is no positive evidence, one submit-only retry is allowed. rebind_submit_retry_count=1/status=started is written before Enter or the send click, and the text is not filled again. A restart after that latch does not press Enter again. Empty composer with no evidence fails closed as no_evidence and does not retry. Future send confirmation: send_to_chatgpt no longer counts as sent before Enter. Hydrate records attempted before the call and rebind_bootstrap_sent only when send returns True. Confirmation is exact user message, generation start, or a new usable /c/ URL, not an already-open conversation URL. If the exact text remains in the composer, one submit-only retry is allowed; otherwise the call returns false and the rebind fails as submit_unconfirmed without claiming bootstrap_sent. A confirmed submit that still has no URL keeps submission confirmed and url pending instead of erasing later finalization. Logs contain tokens only and do not include bootstrap text. CHECK_INTERVAL stays 5. The 2.2.10 raw-to-api failover is unchanged. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not modified. Phase 2 and live mailbox were not enabled.
